competences.description: Attacks all enemies 4 times. The first hit removes 1 beneficial effect with a 75% chance, the second hit decreases their Defense for 2 turns with a 75% chance, the third hit grants Seal for 2 turns with a 75% chance, and the fourth hit disturbs HP recovery for 2 turns with a 75% chance.

Attacks the enemy 7 times. First to sixth hits remove 1 beneficial effect with a 20% chance and stun for 1 turn with a 20% chance. The last hit deals damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken.
Attacks the enemy to instantly defeat the target. This skill can be used when the boss has no weapons.
